mapping_policy: Minimum conservative consumers, widened by transitive local Mojo imports before a future build. Every selected card's complete arm defines are applied to every affected FAST binding. Unchanged dependencies are shared only with identical provenance.

AFCL-G01.source_reason: Exact neighbors are compiled into the core; UMAP, spectral prediction, trustworthiness, HDBSCAN reachability and prediction import neighbors.estimator.

AFCL-G02.source_reason: The scalar exact-neighbor path shares the same binding consumers as G01; MMA rollback must reach each consumer in BOTH arms.

AFCL-G03.source_reason: DBSCAN epsilon neighborhood is reached through dbscan.estimator in _mojolearn_estimators.

AFCL-G04.source_reason: HDBSCAN core-distance tiling is compiled into _mojolearn_hdbscan.

AFCL-G05.source_reason: KMeans distance assignment reaches core KMeans, GMM initialization, spectral assignment, expanded clustering and IVF/PQ coarse/codebook fitting.

AFCL-G06.source_reason: KMeans grouped reduction is shared by core KMeans and all classical consumers importing cluster.estimator or kmeans fitting internals.

AFCL-G07.source_reason: MiniBatchKMeans native entry is compiled into _mojolearn_x_cluster.

AFCL-G09.source_reason: IVF-flat resident search imports fast_ivf_scan in the IVF binding.

AFCL-G10.source_reason: Dense/sparse UMAP training and transform compile through _mojolearn_metrics.

AFCL-G11.source_reason: Spectral embedding/clustering and UMAP spectral initialization import the spectral Lanczos implementation.

AFCL-G12.source_reason: MeanShift device stages are compiled into expanded clustering.

AFCL-G13.source_reason: KernelDensity native resident estimator imports the modified density kernel.

AFCL-G14.source_reason: Agglomerative single-linkage hierarchy and HDBSCAN share Boruvka consumers; keep both native families in the conservative map even when a workload takes another MST route.
